baseline: HEAD bun-ffi.ts, saved before the owned-response change; shared generated codecs/types and native binary frozen identically for both arms
measurement: Real Bun FFI Frame engine invoke benchEchoBytes: encode, native call, decode and Promise included; byte-for-byte response validation outside timer

protocol.statistics: paired log ratios of per-launch p50; Student t(4) nominal 95% CI, no multiple-comparison correction
protocol.quietSlot: Root and sibling agents confirmed no builds/tests/benchmarks during collection; other system activity was not controlled

limits: Short sequential microbenchmark, not sustained load, concurrency, application latency or memory profiling
64B and 511/512/513B total-frame boundary cases have ratio intervals crossing one; no small-response speed claim
One Apple M1 Max macOS host with Bun 1.4.3; no Linux, other Bun versions, React Native, Tauri or Node extrapolation
Invoke entrypoint calls become two to one for overflow; owned free still adds one FFI call, so total FFI call count is not halved

validation.baselineRed: 2 pass, 1 fail: owned binding invocation counter expected 1 but was 0
validation.packageTests: 68 pass, 0 fail, 10 files: env -u RUSTRA_BUN_LIBRARY bun run --cwd packages/bun test
validation.nativeCorrectness: all 30,000 measured plus 3,000 warmup results compared byte for byte; both arms, 6 payload sizes
validation.producerStability: before/after hashes identical within every launch; native, generated codecs and shared types equal across all launches; only bun-ffi.ts differs between adapter arms
